name: Bezer
overview: Bezer is identified in Scripture as a city of refuge located east of the Jordan River, specifically within the territory of the tribe of Reuben. The books of Deuteronomy and Joshua consistently describe Bezer as situated in the wilderness on the plain, serving as a designated safe haven for those seeking protection. Its inclusion alongside Ramoth in Gilead and Golan in Bashan highlights its role in God's provision for justice and mercy among the tribes of Israel.
